title: Evaluating Governed LLM-Driven ML Experimentation: Lifecycle, Provenance, and Failure Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2611.23678v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agents that run ML experiments are usually judged by the best score they reach. That score says nothing about how it was reached: whether the agent stayed within the files it was allowed to edit, whether failed trials were kept or silently dropped, and whether each keep or discard decision can be traced to its evidence. We propose evaluating such systems on their experimental process as well as their outcome, and we build a governed harness that makes this possible. A control plane, not the LLM that proposes changes, owns each trial's lifecycle, checks its edit scope, decides keep or discard, and appends one record per trial to an append-only ledger. Governance metrics such as the invalid-action rate, the repeated-bad rate and provenance completeness are computed from that ledger. Across six ML tasks, from synthetic logistic regression to language-model training, and 1,445 trials, the same contract applied unchanged. The ledge

translated_title: 评估受治理的LLM驱动的机器学习实验：生命周期、溯源与失败指标
translated_abstract: 运行机器学习实验的自主智能体通常以其达到的最佳分数来评判。但这个分数并不能说明它是如何达到的：智能体是否只编辑了其被允许编辑的文件，失败的试验是被保留还是被悄悄丢弃，以及每个保留或丢弃的决定是否可以追溯到其证据。我们提出在评估这类系统时不仅要看其结果，还要评估其实验过程，并为此构建了一个受治理的测试框架。一个控制平面（而非提出修改的LLM）拥有每个试验的生命周期，检查其编辑范围，决定保留还是丢弃，并将每次试验的一条记录追加到只追加的账本中。诸如无效操作率、重复失败率和溯源完整性等治理指标均从该账本中计算得出。在从合成逻辑回归到语言模型训练的六个机器学习任务、共1,445次试验中，同一套契约保持不变地应用。
tldr: 本文提出应从实验过程而非仅从结果分数来评估LLM驱动的ML实验系统，构建了由控制平面（而非LLM）管理试验生命周期、编辑范围与保留决策、并将记录写入只追加账本的治理框架，从中计算无效操作率、重复失败率和溯源完整性等治理指标，并在六个ML任务共1,445次试验中验证了同一契约的普遍适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes evaluating LLM-driven ML experimentation by process as well as outcome, introducing a governed harness where a control plane (not the LLM) owns each trial's lifecycle, enforces edit scope and keep/discard decisions, and appends records to an append-only ledger from which governance metrics—invalid-action rate, repeated-bad rate, and provenance completeness—are computed, validated unchanged across six ML tasks and 1,445 trials.
